text: Machine-wide work queue: get_prioritized_ideas descends into linked repos, and black-box repo nodes show a status rollup
description:
OBSERVED 2026-11-23: after linking 9 repos into the life graph, value flows into each repo node, but get_prioritized_ideas stops at the box. An agent asked 'what's most valuable on this machine' must call it per graph and compare numbers that aren't on the same scale. The repo node also says nothing about the box's state (40 open ideas, last activity yesterday, vs. an empty or stale space).

Proposal: (a) an opt-in mode where get_prioritized_ideas ranks the calling graph's leaves together with the top leaves of each resolved linked repo, scaling them by the value flowing into that repo node. Read-only, no edges into internals. (b) The repo node shows a rollup: open/partially counts and last activity.

CONFLICT: e81b11c3 says no external ideas are loaded, permanently. (a) needs reading the box's ranking, (b) only aggregates. Needs Felix's decision (see status).

status.comment: QUESTION for Felix: this touches the final black-box decision (e81b11c3). Allow a read-only exception for ranking work and a status rollup (counts and last activity only, no idea rendering or links into the internals)? Or keep the strict box and cancel this?
